text:
Maya (PM): Quick standup — propose a 6-week "latency beta" focused on realtime chat and rerank flows. Goal: start outreach next Monday.
Aaron (PM Research): +1. Recommend we target 3 personas: chat UIs, micro-workflows (sub-200ms), and high-QPS rerank.
Priya (Design): Screener suggestion: one-line usage check and a success checkbox (latency / cost / accuracy). Keep it <2min.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Can we commit Dedicated capacity? We should offer a small canary pool (max 2 partners) or hosted with documented fallbacks.
Sam (SRE): I'll draft a degraded-throughput routing snippet and a runbook template. Need explicit oncall hours during the beta.
Chris (Legal): If we ask for logs or outputs, include a 1-paragraph consent and retention options (30/90/365). Default to 30.
deply-bot: merge queued: beta/invite-playbook <- main :party_parrot:
Aaron (PM Research): Screener draft (short): `1) feature summary 2) avg QPS + p95 3) input token range 4) regulatory flags 5) integration estimate`
Priya (Design): Add "What does success look like?" checkboxes. Also I'll make a short in-product banner copy.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Scoring rubric idea: fit (1-5), effort (1-5), impact (1-5). Invite threshold >=11. Veto if on-prem only.
Maya (PM): Launch gates proposal: Recruit (>=8 qualified), Onboard (>=3 validated in staging), Quality (no >10% regression on key eval), Ops (runbook + fallback verified). Pause if failed.
Aaron (PM Research): Metrics to capture: median latency, cost per 1k tokens, and partner NPS at week 4. Also time-to-first-integration.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Onboarding checklist for staging: scoped API key, model pinned, baseline eval uploaded, canary routing plan.
Sam (SRE): I'll add runbook items: alert thresholds, escalation list, weekend coverage notes.
Chris (Legal): I'll draft consent copy and minimum DPIA note. Keep NDA short.
Priya (Design): Incentives: $500 credit (startups) or co-marketing/case study (enterprise). Offer both.
Maya (PM): Action items: Aaron finalizes screener, Priya does banner + outreach copy, Elena builds rubric + triage plan, Sam stubs runbook, Chris drafts consent. I'll compile a 1-pager by Friday.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Happy to triage invites.
Sam (SRE): Stubbing runbook now.
Aaron (PM Research): Will wire up a simple form + A/B test for copy ("reduce latency" vs "lower cost").
Maya (PM): Thanks all — unless objections, outreach Monday. :rocket:
